scenario: Two cached projections, paired filesystem SHOW reads and a real uncached UI load during copied-snapshot ZIP compression
scope: One Linux native debug run under Xvfb. The UI cache miss is observed through the real presenting-page click and correlated MAIN.SHOW request/reply. Filesystem/OS caches were not flushed and were warmed by library scans and snapshot copying. Filesystem read round trips include JSON parsing and IPC. Visible projection acknowledgments inspect DOM/CSS/RAF progress plus configured fades and native startup handshakes, not physical scanout. No Electron comparison, cold physical-disk result, production tail latency or application-level speedup is certified.

environment.fonts: Noto Color Emoji 2.047 from Ubuntu package copied into isolated XDG profile

workload.generator: Python random.Random(20261018), 256 KiB random bytes hex-encoded and repeated 32 times per fixture
workload.zipVerified: entry lengths, CRCs and complete decompression
workload.backupSnapshot: Private file copies prepared on the ordered owner; compression runs on that same thread while two readers may run independently. Subsequent mutations remain queued.
workload.uncachedShow: One additional fixture is edited in place after the snapshot is ready; its real UI load sees the edit and the archive is verified to retain the original.

overlap: Exact backup listener and backupCompression phase checked before and after each recorded paired cue/filesystem-read sample. The uncached UI load also completes within that phase.
quantiles: nearest rank over this single run; not a production tail-latency estimate

summary.uncachedUiObservedScope: From before the automated click through visible show-grid text, including WebDriver and polling overhead; not an application-only render measurement.
